Initialize missing DEPARE DRVAL2; tessellate HPGL GLES polygons with retained libtess2 instead of desktop GLU.
Enable retained GLES2 S52 branches and shaders; check shader compilation/linking; release context-bound programs/textures.
Apply viewport rotation once: directly for CPU points and in original shader transforms for GLES points; preserve upright text and display-coordinate label bounds.
Correct typed Striper deallocation and initialize maximum strip vertex count, detected by AddressSanitizer.
Replace signed-negative fixed-point shifts with equivalent multiplication; copy packed WKB/SENC/S57 scalars into aligned local values, detected by UBSan.
Rotate direct CPU chart coordinates for the No5 viewport; OpenCPN CPU ChartCanvas ordinarily performed the final chart rotation.
Retain OSENC 201 writer/ingest and original line assembly/priority/selection. Exclude desktop SENC progress/dialog/temporary update orchestration and drive data operations from No5.
Friend facade/cache for native lifetime and rendering access; no OpenCPN types cross the Kotlin API.

Batch visible solid-area triangles/strips/fans within one rule using bounded ushort indices over unchanged float client vertices; preserve visibility, winding and draw order, retaining the original path for unsupported representations.

Sample nested S52 rule/text/symbol/line/area and deferred-tessellation wall time without changing drawing; expose coarse frame-stage wall and thread CPU time separately from selected GL API wall time.

Restore an area-pattern matrix using the active area-pattern program location, avoiding a driver-dependent cross-program uniform location from the legacy colour shader (PowerVR startup GL_INVALID_OPERATION).
Independent full-render probe only: count existing original/reduced position-BBox decisions and sample query time; original decisions retained, no new culling policy.
Audit repair: context-owned S52/C/font shader caches with thread-local active views; chart selection subtracts retained NOCOVR polygons.
Preserve OSENC integer/real attribute lists as the comma-list representation consumed by S52; validate packed lengths and copy aligned scalars, retaining all values for object details.
Retain derived area GPU buffers without changing semantic CPU tessellation, original primitive order, clipping, anchors or query geometry; release with the owning EGL context and resident cell.
Preserve case-sensitive standard and inland ENC object acronyms during CSV preload, so custom filters use exact dictionary identifiers without conflating ACHARE and achare.

    "attribute vec2 position;\n"
    "attribute highp vec2 segmentStart;\n"
    "varying highp vec2 startPos;\n"
    "uniform mat4 MVMatrix;\n"
    "uniform mat4 TransformMatrix;\n"
    "void main() {\n"
    "   startPos = segmentStart;\n"
    "   gl_Position = MVMatrix * TransformMatrix * vec4(position, 0.0, 1.0);\n"
    "}\n";

    "precision highp float;\n"
    "uniform sampler2D uTex;\n"
    "varying highp vec2 startPos;\n"
    "uniform float texWidth;\n"
    "uniform float dashFactor;\n"
    "uniform vec4 color;\n"
    "void main() {\n"
    "   float d = distance(gl_FragCoord.xy, startPos);\n"
    "   float x = mod(d,texWidth) / texWidth;\n"
    "   if(x < dashFactor) gl_FragColor = color;\n"
    "   else gl_FragColor = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);\n"
    "}\n";
